title:
Kiko and the
Remembering Fire
description: A curious tortoise follows his questions into the forest, toward a fire that has never gone out.

lines.text: Long ago, in a small village surrounded by forests,
there lived a curious tortoise named Kiko.
Kiko was known throughout the village for asking too many questions.
ask: Why does Kiko ask so many questions?
Why does the moon follow travellers?
Why do birds sing before sunrise?

lines.text: and why the old baobab tree never seemed to lose its leaves.
But there was one mystery nobody could explain.
Every night, deep inside the forest,
a fire could be seen burning beneath an ancient tree.

ask: Why does the fire never go out?

lines.text: Not even during the heaviest storms.
ask: How can a fire survive a storm?

lines.text: The villagers called it the Remembering Fire.
ask: Why is it called the Remembering Fire?

lines.text: They believed it held the memories of everyone who had ever lived.
ask: Can a fire really hold memories?
